description: LINKS Mobilys provides the open-source LINKS Mobilys web tool for public-transport planning using GTFS and boarding and alighting data. The provider is Japan Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism. Geographical and temporal coverage: Japan's 2025 development project provides repository, manual and technical-verification links; users supply local networks. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The linked GitHub repository is MIT-licensed (copyright MLIT Japan). The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
